summary.en: Records approved by a reviewer who read the original.

scope: Reviewer-approved feeding, nutrition and toxicity records. A record is not a feeding grade.

verification_levels.reviewed_source_record: a reviewer read the original and approved the record

sources.citation: Rodrigues, J. F. M. & Oliveira, S. P. de (2016) Can tortoises facilitate the germination of plants with dry fruits? A simulation of the effects of Chelonoidis carbonarius (Testudines: Testudinidae) on the germination of Leucaena leucocephala (Fabaceae). Rodriguésia 67(3): 661-666.

Falcón, W., Moll, D. & Hansen, D. M. 2018. Frugivory and seed dispersal by chelonians: a review and synthesis. bioRxiv preprint 379933 (v1, posted 30 July 2018); published 2020 in Biological Reviews 95: 142-166.

Wagle, R. C., Thapa Chhetry, D., Bist, B. B., Adhikari, R. C., Rai, T. P. & Ranapaheli, A. (2026) Biorhythm, feeding preferences and growth of Indotestudo elongata (Blyth, 1854) in Turtle Rescue and Conservation Centre, Jhapa, Nepal. Published online 26 March 2026.

records.locator: Preprint PDF p. 37, section on seed damage after gut passage ("virtually all the seeds of Solanum aldabrense were recovered intact from a single Aldabra giant tortoise scat (WF, pers. obs.)")

plant_part.en: seeds (recovered from scat after the fruit was eaten)

finding.ko: 알다브라 거북의 분변 한 개에서 씨앗이 거의 모두 온전한 상태로 나왔다고 저자가 직접 관찰해 종설에 보고함
finding.en: Almost all seeds were recovered intact from one Aldabra giant tortoise scat (the authors' own observation, reported in the review)

records.reviewer: Claude (AI review requested by the repository owner, 2026-10-23)

records.locator: Preprint PDF p. 73, Figure 1 caption, panel c (Aldabra giant tortoises "often been observed eating ripe fruits, while ignoring green ones (e.g., of Ficus nautarum; c)")

finding.ko: 알다브라 거북이 익은 열매는 먹고 덜 익은 초록 열매는 먹지 않는 모습이 자주 관찰됨
finding.en: Often observed eating ripe fruits while ignoring green ones

records.reviewer: Claude (AI review requested by the repository owner, 2026-10-23)

records.locator: PDF p. 2 (printed p. 662), Introduction, last paragraph ("In captive conditions, we observed that individuals of C. carbonarius also freely eat many parts of Leucaena leucocephala (Lam.) de Wit, a legume plant that is very common in the area of Ceará ... where these captive tortoises forage")

plant_part.en: many parts (the source does not name them)

finding.ko: 브라질 포르탈레자(세아라) 대학 구내의 사육 붉은다리거북이 이 식물의 여러 부위를 자유롭게 먹는 것을 저자들이 직접 관찰함. 실험 자체는 씨앗 발아 시뮬레이션이며 급여량·안전성은 다루지 않음
finding.en: The authors observed captive red-footed tortoises at the Federal University of Ceará (Fortaleza, Brazil) freely eating many parts of the plant. The study itself simulates seed germination and does not address amounts or safety

records.locator: PDF p. 15, Table 18 "Herbivory" (items provided by the researchers; "Preferences (%)" = percentage of the nine tortoises that fed on the item, section 3.2.2; items rejected by all nine were not listed); row "Guava | Psidium guajava | fruit | 100.0"

finding.ko: 네팔 TRCC의 사육 개체 9마리에게 제공했을 때 100.0%(9/9마리)가 먹음. 선호도 표이며 급여량·빈도·안전성은 다루지 않음
finding.en: Offered to nine captive tortoises at TRCC, Nepal, 100.0% (9 of 9) fed on it. A preference table; it gives no amount, frequency or safety finding
